'''Fixer 41''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] member of [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] on the Sith capital [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] where she trained fellow Sith in the art of [[Slicer/Legends|slicing]].
